title: GeoVerse: World-Consistent Novel View Synthesis in Geometric Latent Space
title_zh: GeoVerse: 世界一致的几何潜在空间中新颖视图合成

paragraphs.en: Novel view synthesis from sparse images must reconcile faithful reconstruction of observed regions with plausible completion of unseen content, while maintaining world consistency across viewpoints. Existing geometry-based methods preserve observed scene structure but often struggle to complete unseen regions, whereas video generative models offer rich appearance priors but accumulate inconsistencies during sequential view generation. We propose GeoVerse, a framework that synthesizes world-consistent novel views by performing generation within the geometric latent space of a pretrained 3D foundation model and injecting appearance priors from a video generative model. Specifically, GeoVerse extracts multilevel features from Wan2.2 VACE and injects them into the geometric latent diffusion model via a ControlNet-style adapter, incorporating video-learned appearance priors to enhance structural completion. To enforce cross-view coherence, a global spatial memory continuously aggregates observed and synthesized content, reprojecting target-aligned guidance to anchor subsequent predictions to a shared scene representation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate improved visual quality and geometric consistency, with a 2.23 dB higher PSNR on DL3DV and 32.4% lower ATE on Mip-NeRF360 compared to GLD.

paragraphs.en: Novel View Synthesis (NVS) is a cornerstone task in 3D computer vision that aims to render photorealistic images from specified, previously unseen target viewpoints given one or more reference images ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2024a ) . A fundamental challenge in NVS lies in balancing reconstruction fidelity during view interpolation with generative capability during view extrapolation, faithfully aggregating observed scene content while plausibly completing unobserved regions. To bridge faithful reconstruction with generative completion, maintaining a unified geometric representation is crucial for ensuring spatial and semantic coherence across shifting viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 新型视角合成（NVS）是三维计算机视觉中的一个核心任务，其目标是在给定一张或多张参考图像的情况下，从指定的、此前未见的目标视角渲染出逼真的图像（Mildenhall 等人，2021；Yu 等人，2024a）。 NVS 的一个根本性挑战在于，如何在视角插值过程中保持重建的保真度，同时又在视角外推过程中发挥生成能力，既忠实聚合已观察到的场景内容，又能合理地补全未观察到的区域。 为了在忠实重建与生成式补全之间取得平衡，维持统一的几何表示对于确保在不同视角下空间与语义的一致性至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Early NVS frameworks were predominantly constrained to per-scene optimization, with pioneering paradigms like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) fitting scene-specific representations on dense captures. To bypass scene-specific training bottlenecks, recent generalizable architectures leverage scaled data to predict Gaussian primitives directly from sparse views in a feed-forward manner ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025a ) . Spurred by 3D foundation models ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , these feed-forward methods achieve rapid feed-forward reconstruction with strong geometry grounding ( Jiang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . However, bound by deterministic geometric formulations, pure reconstruction frameworks inherently lack generative imagination, frequently producing severe visual artifacts, blurriness, or hollow voids when synthesizing unobserved regions under large camera motions.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的 NVS 框架主要局限于场景特定的优化，其开创性范式如神经辐射场（NeRF）（Mildenhall 等，2021）和 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）（Kerbl 等，2023），均在密集采集数据上拟合特定场景的表示。 为突破场景特定训练的瓶颈，近期的可泛化架构利用扩展数据，以前向方式直接从稀疏视角预测高斯原语（Chen 等，2024；Jiang 等，2025a）。 在 3D 基础模型（Wang 等，2024；Wang 等，2025a）的推动下，这些前向方法实现了快速的前向重建，并具备强大的几何约束能力（Jiang 等，2025a；Liu 等，2025）。 然而，由于受确定性几何公式的限制，纯粹的重建框架本质上缺乏生成性想象力，在合成大视角运动下未观测到的区域时，常常会产生严重的视觉伪影、模糊或空洞。

paragraphs.en: To compensate for the limited extrapolation capability of reconstruction methods, video diffusion models have recently been repurposed for view synthesis ( Yu et al., 2024a ) , leveraging rich appearance priors learned from vast video corpora ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . Despite their expressive completion, applying video models directly or sequentially to 3D scenes often accumulates cross-frame inconsistencies, causing drift and structural breakdown over long horizons ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . To enforce spatial consistency, hybrid frameworks align video diffusion features with 3D representations ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , yet they remain burdened by the heavy computational overhead of synthesizing dense video frames. More recently, Geometry Latent Diffusion (GLD) ( Jang et al., 2026 ) has emerged as a promising alternative that generates novel views directly within a geometric latent space. Built upon 3D foundation models such as DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , which is pretrained on large-scale data with depth and camera-pose supervision to learn cross-view attention, this space provides a robust structural foundation and a geometric prior for single-pass consistency. Furthermore, GLD’s RGB head effectively decodes fine texture and appearance details from these features ( Jang et al., 2026 ) . However, restricted by a limited training distribution, GLD struggles with generative fidelity and stability on in-the-wild scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥补重建方法有限的推断能力，视频扩散模型最近被重新用于视图合成（Yu et al., 2024a），利用从海量视频语料中学习到的丰富外观先验（Wan et al., 2025）。 尽管这些模型具有强大的生成能力，但将视频模型直接或顺序地应用于三维场景时，往往会累积跨帧不一致性，导致长时间序列中出现漂移和结构崩溃（Wu et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026）。 为了强制空间一致性，混合框架会将视频扩散特征与三维表示对齐（Wu et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2026），但它们仍然受到生成密集视频帧所带来的沉重计算负担。 最近，几何潜在扩散模型（GLD）（Jang et al., 2026）作为一种有前景的替代方案应运而生，它可以直接在几何潜在空间中生成新的视图。 GLD 建立在三维基础模型之上，例如 DA3（Lin et al., 2025），该模型通过在包含深度和相机姿态监督的大规模数据上进行预训练，以学习跨视图注意力机制，从而为单次处理的一致性提供了稳健的结构基础和几何先验。 此外，GLD 的 RGB 头能够有效地从这些特征中解码精细的纹理和外观细节（Jang et al., 2026）。 然而，由于训练分布有限，GLD 在真实世界场景中的生成保真度和稳定性方面存在困难。

paragraphs.en: In summary, existing NVS approaches struggle to seamlessly harmonize rigid 3D geometric consistency with expressively detailed generative completion. To bridge this gap, we present GeoVerse , a novel framework that endows geometric latent diffusion with rich video generative priors while maintaining structural consistency via a persistent spatial memory. We address these limitations through three key designs. First, we incorporate Wan2.2 VACE ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025b ) , a high-capacity video diffusion model pretrained on extensive video data, to enrich the geometric latent space with powerful appearance priors and plausible scene completion. Second, we scale the 3D training corpus from 4 to 15 diverse real and synthetic datasets to broaden scene coverage and enhance cross-domain generalization. Beyond single-pass consistency, successive view expansion requires a persistent representation across multiple inference steps. Inspired by ViewCrafter ( Yu et al., 2024a ) , we maintain a global colored point-cloud memory that accumulates historical content. Reprojecting this memory into target views provides pixel-aligned guidance, anchoring multi-step predictions while facilitating unobserved region completion. Leveraging this structured guidance, we employ reflow distillation ( Yan et al., 2024 ) to reduce the denoising process to 4 steps, cutting per-inference latency from over 100 seconds to under 10 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，现有的 NVS 方法难以将刚性的三维几何一致性与富有表现力的详细生成式补全无缝融合。 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 GeoVerse——一种新颖的框架，它通过持续的空间记忆在保持结构一致性的同时，为几何潜在扩散模型注入了丰富的视频生成先验知识。 我们通过三种关键设计来解决这些局限性。 首先，我们引入了 Wan2.2 VACE（Wan 等，2025；Jiang 等，2025b），这是一种在海量视频数据上预训练的高容量视频扩散模型，用于为几何潜在空间注入强大的外观先验和合理的场景补全能力。 其次，我们将三维训练语料库从 4 个扩展至 15 个多样化的真实与合成数据集，以扩大场景覆盖范围并增强跨域泛化能力。 除了单步一致性之外，连续视角的扩展需要在多个推理步骤中维持一个持续有效的表示。 受 ViewCrafter（Yu 等，2024a）的启发，我们维护了一个全局彩色点云记忆，用于累积历史内容。 将该记忆重投影到目标视角中，可提供像素对齐的引导，从而锚定多步预测，同时促进未观察区域的补全。 借助这种结构化引导，我们采用 reflow distillation（Yan 等，2024）将去噪过程缩短至 4 步，使每次推理的延迟从超过 100 秒降至 10 秒以下。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a novel framework that seamlessly bridges geometric latent diffusion with expressive video generative priors for world-consistent novel view synthesis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的框架，该框架将几何潜在扩散模型与富有表现力的视频生成先验无缝结合，以实现与世界一致的新视角合成。

paragraphs.en: We propose a global spatial memory mechanism that provides target-aligned input guidance, effectively enforcing sustained long-sequence geometric consistency across extended trajectories without cumulative drift.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种全局空间记忆机制，该机制可提供与目标对齐的输入引导，从而有效确保在扩展轨迹中保持长序列几何一致性，而不会出现累积漂移。

paragraphs.en: We scale up model training across diverse real and synthetic multi-view corpora to significantly enhance cross-domain generalization and integrate a few-step reflow distillation scheme to significantly accelerate inference to under 10 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多样化的真实与合成多视角语料库上扩展模型训练，以显著提升跨域泛化能力，并引入几步重流蒸馏方案，将推理时间大幅缩短至10秒以下。

paragraphs.en: Focusing on fusing existing scene content within captured view bounds, reconstructive novel view synthesis was initially dominated by scene-specific optimization. Pioneered by NeRF ( Mildenhall et al., 2021 ) , implicit radiance fields achieved novel view rendering through differentiable volume rendering, which was later accelerated and scaled by subsequent variants ( Barron et al., 2021 ; Müller et al., 2022 ) . To overcome the implicit rendering bottleneck, 3DGS ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) introduced explicit 3D Gaussian primitives for real-time synthesis, followed by improvements in anti-aliasing and geometry modeling ( Yu et al., 2024b ; Lu et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2024 ) . While capable of rendering high-fidelity views, these per-scene representations suffer from long optimization times and strictly require dense multi-view coverage. To bypass per-scene optimization, feed-forward frameworks learn generalizable mappings from sparse inputs to novel target views. Early generalizable architectures like MVSplat ( Chen et al., 2024 ) leverage plane-sweep cost volumes for 3D Gaussian prediction, while LVSM ( Jin et al., 2024 ) scales transformer-based synthesis with minimal explicit geometric priors. Accelerated by 3D foundation models like VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , recent frameworks seamlessly unify camera estimation and feed-forward reconstruction. Specifically, AnySplat ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) jointly recovers camera poses and 3D Gaussians from unconstrained views, whereas WorldMirror ( Liu et al., 2025 ) incorporates multi-source geometric priors. In the monocular regime, SHARP ( Mescheder et al., 2026 ) regresses a metric 3D Gaussian field from a single image in one forward pass. Although feed-forward methods excel at interpolative synthesis within bounded views, extrapolating to unobserved regions remains inherently ambiguous.
paragraphs.zh: 最初的重建性新视角合成方法主要关注于融合已捕获视场边界内的现有场景内容，并以场景特定的优化为主导。 以 NeRF（Mildenhall 等人，2021）为开端，隐式辐射场通过可微分体积渲染实现了新视角渲染，随后其后续变体（Barron 等人，2021；Müller 等人，2022）进一步加速并扩展了该方法。 为克服隐式渲染的瓶颈，3DGS（Kerbl 等人，2023）引入了显式三维高斯原语以实现实时合成，随后在抗锯齿和几何建模方面取得了改进（Yu 等人，2024b；Lu 等人，2024；Ren 等人，2024）。 尽管这些逐场景表示能够渲染高保真视角，但它们存在优化时间长的缺点，且严格依赖密集的多视角覆盖。 为绕过逐场景优化的限制，前馈框架从稀疏输入中学习可泛化的映射，以生成新的目标视角。 早期的可泛化架构如 MVSplat（Chen 等人，2024）利用平面扫描代价体积进行三维高斯预测，而 LVSM（Jin 等人，2024）则通过最小显式几何先验扩展了基于变换器的合成方法。 在 VGGT（Wang 等人，2025a）等三维基础模型的加速下，近期的框架实现了相机估计与前馈重建的无缝统一。 具体而言，AnySplat（Jiang 等人，2025a）可从无约束视角中联合恢复相机姿态和三维高斯场，而 WorldMirror（Liu 等人，2025）则整合了多源几何先验。 在单目场景下，SHARP（Mescheder 等人，2026）通过单次前向传播从单张图像中回归出度量三维高斯场。 尽管前馈方法在有限视场内进行插值合成方面表现优异，但向未观测区域的外推本质上仍存在歧义。

paragraphs.en: Generative novel view synthesis introduces generative priors to synthesize content beyond the observed scene coverage. ViewCrafter combines point-based 3D clues with a pretrained video diffusion model and iteratively expands both its camera trajectory and reconstructed content ( Yu et al., 2024a ) . NeoVerse couples feed-forward 4D reconstruction with novel-trajectory video generation to model scenes from in-the-wild monocular videos ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . To reduce drift over longer horizons, spatial-memory approaches explicitly store and retrieve previously generated scene content: geometry-grounded long-term memory caches 3D history, while Mirage lifts diffusion latents into a persistent 3D cache and queries it through latent-space warping ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Lyra 2.0 combines per frame geometric matching for history retrieval with self augmented history training to suppress cumulative drift during long sequence generation ( Shen et al., 2026 ) . These methods improve long-horizon consistency while retaining a video-based generation pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式新视角合成引入了生成先验，以合成超出观测场景覆盖范围的内容。 ViewCrafter 将基于点的三维线索与预训练的视频扩散模型相结合，并迭代扩展其相机轨迹和重建内容（Yu et al., 2024a）。 NeoVerse 将前馈式四维重建与新轨迹视频生成相耦合，以从野外单目视频中建模场景（Yang et al., 2026）。 为减少长时间跨度内的漂移，空间记忆方法会显式存储和检索先前生成的场景内容：基于几何的长期记忆缓存会保存三维历史，而 Mirage 则将扩散潜在变量提升至持久化的三维缓存中，并通过潜在空间形变进行查询（Wu et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026）。 Lyra 2.0 将每帧的几何匹配用于历史检索，并结合自增强历史训练，以抑制长序列生成过程中的累积漂移（Shen et al., 2026）。 这些方法在保持基于视频的生成功程的同时，提升了长时间跨度下的一致性。

paragraphs.en: Geometric foundation models offer a complementary route to geometry-aware extrapolation. Geometry Forcing supervises intermediate video-diffusion representations with features from a geometric foundation model, while Gen3R adapts VGGT tokens into geometric latents and aligns them with pretrained video appearance latents for joint RGB and 3D generation ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Although these methods improve the 3D awareness of video diffusion, their generation process remains organized as a video sequence. Geometric Latent Diffusion (GLD) instead repurposes the geometric feature space of DA3 as the native latent space for multi-view diffusion, enabling direct generation at specified target cameras with strong cross-view correspondence ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Jang et al., 2026 ) . Unlike prior sequence-based approaches, GeoVerse adopts the geometric-latent formulation, augmented by video generative priors and a persistent 3D memory, enabling direct target-view synthesis free of dense video interpolation.
paragraphs.zh: 几何基础模型为几何感知的外推提供了一种补充性路径。 Geometry Forcing 利用几何基础模型的特征来监督中间的视频扩散表示，而 Gen3R 则将 VGGT 标记转换为几何潜在变量，并将其与预训练的视频外观潜在变量对齐，以实现 RGB 和 3D 的联合生成（Wu et al., 2025；Huang et al., 2026）。 尽管这些方法提升了视频扩散对 3D 结构的感知能力，但其生成过程仍然以视频序列的形式组织。 相比之下，几何潜在扩散（GLD）将 DA3 的几何特征空间重新用作多视角扩散的原生潜在空间，从而能够在指定的目标相机视角下直接生成具有强跨视角对应关系的图像（Lin et al., 2025；Jang et al., 2026）。 与先前的序列基方法不同，GeoVerse 采用了几何潜在框架，并通过视频生成先验和持久化的 3D 记忆进行增强，实现了无需密集视频插值的直接目标视角合成。

Standard image-video latent spaces provide robust appearance priors but struggle to maintain explicit 3D correspondence across novel viewpoints ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) . In contrast, GLD combines the geometry head of Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) for spatial layouts (depth and raymaps) with an auxiliary RGB head for high-frequency textures ( Jang et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: Spatial Memory Aggregation. To maintain multi-round scene consistency, GeoVerse incrementally updates a colored point-cloud memory 𝐌 r \mathbf{M}^{r} in a shared coordinate system ( Yu et al., 2024a ; Ren et al., 2025 ) . Context observations initialize the memory as 𝐌 0 = 𝐏 0 \mathbf{M}^{0}=\mathbf{P}^{0} using DA3-predicted ( Lin et al., 2025 ) or metric depth if available. For generated rounds, predicted depth is scale-aligned via 𝐃 ~ i r = s r ⋆ ​ 𝐃 i r ^ \widetilde{\mathbf{D}}_{i}^{r}=s_{r}^{\star}\hat{\mathbf{D}_{i}^{r}} using a camera-center similarity transform. Back-projecting valid pixels with 𝐃 ~ i r \widetilde{\mathbf{D}}_{i}^{r} and camera parameters 𝐂 i \mathbf{C}_{i} constructs a point set 𝐏 r \mathbf{P}^{r} containing 3D positions, colors, and confidence weights. paragraphs.en: Hierarchical Few-Step Sampling. We allocate three denoising steps to Level-1 for primary multi-view generation and one step to the frozen Level-0 cascade for shallow feature recovery. This budget allocation is empirically grounded in Table 2 and Fig. 4 : three Level-1 steps recover noticeably finer details than a single step, whereas a single L0 cascade step suffices to match the quality of 49 steps. paragraphs.en: Starting from a pretrained GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , GeoVerse is trained on 15 real and synthetic multi-view datasets using DA3-Base ( Lin et al., 2025 ) at 504 × 504 504\times 504 resolution, with eight ordered views per sample (one to four selected as context views). Both stages are executed on 32 NVIDIA A800 GPUs using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with a global batch size of 32. Adaptation hyperparameters are set to ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) , gradient-norm clipping at 1.0, and an EMA decay of 0.9995. paragraphs.en: GeoVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance across all four benchmarks in Tab. 1 , surpassing GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) in PSNR by 2.23 dB on DL3DV and 2.45 dB on Mip-NeRF 360. These gains translate into clear visual improvements (Fig. 3 ), effectively suppressing smearing and ghosting while recovering crisp object boundaries and faithful surface colors relative to context views. Unlike baselines that introduce misplaced structures or color shifts, GeoVerse preserves scene identity during synthesis. On long-sequence ScanNetv2 testing across three rounds, GeoVerse boosts PSNR from 15.33 dB (GLD) to 19.65 dB, maintaining temporal stability across large indoor structures.
paragraphs.zh: GeoVerse 在表 1 中所有四个基准测试上都实现了当前最先进的性能，在 DL3DV 上的 PSNR 比 GLD（Jang 等人，2026）高出 2.23 dB，在 Mip-NeRF 360 上高出 2.45 dB。 这些提升带来了明显的视觉改进（图 3），有效抑制了模糊和重影现象，同时相较于上下文视图恢复了清晰的物体边界和逼真的表面颜色。 与那些会引入错误位置结构或颜色偏移的基线方法不同，GeoVerse 在合成过程中保留了场景的原始特征。 在三轮长序列 ScanNetv2 测试中，GeoVerse 将 PSNR 从 GLD 的 15.33 dB 提升至 19.65 dB，并在大型室内结构中保持了时间稳定性。

paragraphs.en: GeoVerse lowers ATE on Mip-NeRF 360 from 0.105 (GLD ( Jang et al., 2026 ) ) to 0.071, representing a 32.4% improvement. As reflected in Tab. 1 and Fig. 3 , lower pose errors manifest as enhanced 3D structural fidelity, preserving intricate geometry like outdoor furniture without distortion. Over long sequences, key scene elements retain cross-round consistency, avoiding the structural repetitions and layout shifts prevalent in baselines. This validates the role of persistent spatial memory in anchoring new updates to accumulated context. While performance varies slightly across specific metrics, where some baselines achieve lower reprojection or translation errors on individual datasets, GeoVerse maintains significantly better global scene coherence.

paragraphs.en: We analyze the denoising budget within GLD’s hierarchical sampling framework ( Jang et al., 2026 ) , with Level-1 acceleration based on reflow ( Yan et al., 2024 ) . Table 2 evaluates denoising budget trade offs on DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) . Reducing Level-1 generation from three steps to one lowers runtime from 9.24 to 6.07 s, yet worsens LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) from 0.339 to 0.367. As shown in Fig. 4 , this setting causes a loss of fine brick textures and object boundaries despite higher PSNR, showing that PSNR alone fails to reflect perceptual quality. On the other hand, cutting Level 0 cascade steps from 49 to one preserves comparable local details with an LPIPS of 0.342 versus 0.339 at much lower latency. These complementary trends validate our 3 + 1 3+1 budget allocation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了 GLD 分层采样框架（Jang et al., 2026）中的去噪预算，其中 Level-1 加速基于 reflow（Yan et al., 2024）。 表 2 评估了 DL3DV（Ling et al., 2024）上的去噪预算权衡。 将 Level-1 的生成步骤从三步减少到一步，可将运行时间从 9.24 秒降至 6.07 秒，但 LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018）却从 0.339 恶化至 0.367。 如图 4 所示，尽管该设置带来了更高的 PSNR，但却导致了精细砖块纹理和物体边界的丢失，表明仅凭 PSNR 无法反映感知质量。 另一方面，将 Level 0 的级联步骤从 49 步削减至一步，在显著降低延迟的同时，仍能保留相当程度的局部细节，LPIPS 为 0.342（对比 0.339）。 这些互补的趋势验证了我们的 3 + 1 预算分配方案。

paragraphs.en: While GeoVerse achieves strong multi-view consistency and high inference efficiency, two main limitations remain. First, its peak visual fidelity is constrained by the appearance capacity of the DA3 feature space. By prioritizing speed through compact feature conditioning, GeoVerse may not fully match the fine texture richness of computationally heavy, full-scale video diffusion models. Second, multi-round consistency depends on both the underlying geometry backbone and synthesized RGB coherence. In textureless or complex regions, initial depth errors and generated appearance drift can accumulate through spatial memory updates, occasionally compromising cross-view alignment across long trajectories. Improving joint 3D geometric and photometric stability remains a key objective for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 GeoVerse 实现了强大的多视角一致性和高推理效率，但仍存在两个主要局限性。 首先，其峰值视觉保真度受到 DA3 特征空间外观容量的限制。 由于通过紧凑的特征条件化优先追求速度，GeoVerse 可能无法完全匹配计算密集型全尺寸视频扩散模型所具备的精细纹理丰富度。 其次，多轮一致性既依赖于底层的几何主干结构，也依赖于合成的 RGB 一致性。 在缺乏纹理或结构复杂的区域中，初始的深度误差和生成的外观漂移可能会通过空间记忆更新而累积，偶尔会破坏长轨迹中的跨视角对齐。 提升联合 3D 几何与光度稳定性仍然是未来研究的关键目标。

paragraphs.en: We introduced GeoVerse, a framework designed to resolve the fundamental trade off between geometric consistency and generative completion in novel view synthesis. By embedding pretrained video appearance priors into a 3D geometric latent diffusion model, GeoVerse generates high fidelity views while maintaining rigid spatial structure. Our global spatial memory further prevents cumulative drift across extended trajectories by grounding ongoing synthesis in accumulated 3D scene context. Accelerated by a few step reflow distillation scheme, GeoVerse achieves over 17 times speedup compared to GLD while setting new state of the art benchmarks in visual quality and pose accuracy. By demonstrating the effectiveness of combining video learned priors with geometric latent spaces, GeoVerse establishes a robust foundation and offers valuable insights toward building multi view consistent video world models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GeoVerse，这是一个旨在解决新型视角合成中几何一致性与生成性补全之间根本权衡的框架。 通过将预训练的视频外观先验嵌入到三维几何潜在扩散模型中，GeoVerse 能够在保持刚性空间结构的同时生成高保真度的视角。 我们的全局空间记忆机制进一步防止了长期轨迹中的累积漂移，它将持续的合成过程锚定在已积累的三维场景上下文中。 通过几步重流蒸馏方案实现加速，GeoVerse 与 GLD 相比速度提升了超过 17 倍，同时在视觉质量和姿态准确性方面树立了新的基准纪录。 通过展示结合视频学习先验与几何潜在空间的有效性，GeoVerse 建立了一个坚实的基础，并为构建多视角一致的视频世界模型提供了宝贵的见解。

paragraphs.en: Wan is a video diffusion framework with a causal video VAE, a text encoder, and a diffusion Transformer ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . In the standard generation pipeline, the Transformer iteratively denoises a video latent under text and optional visual conditions, and the VAE decoder converts the final latent into RGB frames. Visual inputs requiring latent encoding are processed by the VAE encoder before entering the corresponding conditioning path. Wan2.2-A14B uses separate high- and low-noise experts for different portions of the denoising trajectory, with approximately 14 billion active parameters per step.
paragraphs.zh: Wan 是一个视频扩散框架，包含一个因果视频 VAE、一个文本编码器和一个扩散 Transformer（Wan 等，2025）。 在标准的生成流程中，Transformer 会在文本和可选的视觉条件下迭代地去除视频潜在表示中的噪声，而 VAE 解码器则会将最终的潜在表示转换为 RGB 帧。 需要潜在编码的视觉输入在进入相应的条件路径之前，会先由 VAE 编码器进行处理。 Wan2.2-A14B 为去噪轨迹的不同阶段使用了独立的高噪声和低噪声专家，每一步约有 140 亿个活跃参数。

paragraphs.en: VACE ( Jiang et al., 2025b ) adds a unified interface for reference images, source videos, and spatiotemporal masks. Its Video Condition Unit organizes these inputs for reference-guided generation, video editing, inpainting, outpainting, and temporal extension. The standard VACE pipeline tokenizes visual conditions through context encoding and introduces them into the video backbone through context adapters. Its training curriculum progresses from foundational completion tasks to multiple references and task combinations, followed by quality refinement. These components provide visual completion cues that complement the geometric representation used by GeoVerse.
paragraphs.zh: VACE（Jiang 等人，2025b）为参考图像、源视频和时空掩码添加了一个统一接口。 其视频条件单元将这些输入组织起来，用于参考引导生成、视频编辑、内容填充、内容扩展和时间延伸。 标准的 VACE 流程通过上下文编码对视觉条件进行分词，并通过上下文适配器将其引入视频主干网络。 其训练课程从基础完成任务逐步过渡到多参考和任务组合，最后进行质量优化。 这些组件提供了视觉完成提示，以补充 GeoVerse 所使用的几何表示。

paragraphs.en: The Wan technical report describes pretraining on billions of images and videos ( Wan et al., 2025 ) . The Wan2.2 release reports 65.6% more images and 83.2% more videos than Wan2.1; these are relative increases, rather than disclosed absolute counts for the Wan2.2 corpus. VACE constructs task-specific conditions from filtered videos, including segmentation masks, reference crops, depth, pose, and optical flow ( Jiang et al., 2025b ) . The available model card does not specify an absolute training-set size for the particular Wan2.2-VACE-Fun checkpoint used here. These external pretraining corpora are separate from GeoVerse’s multi-view training data in Sec. D .
paragraphs.zh: Wan 技术报告描述了在数十亿张图像和视频上进行预训练（Wan 等人，2025）。 Wan2.2 版本报告称其图像数量比 Wan2.1 增加了 65.6%，视频数量增加了 83.2%；这些是相对增幅，而非 Wan2.2 语料库的明确绝对数量。 VACE 从筛选后的视频中构建任务特定的条件，包括分割掩码、参考裁剪、深度、姿态和光流（Jiang 等人，2025b）。 现有的模型卡并未说明此处使用的特定 Wan2.2-VACE-Fun 检查点的绝对训练集规模。 这些外部预训练语料库与 D 节中 GeoVerse 的多视角训练数据相互独立。

paragraphs.en: Following the shared-attention design of Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , we couple video-prior tokens and geometric latent tokens through attention while retaining separate processing streams. At each coupled layer, modality-specific projections map the two representations into a common attention space. The geometric stream produces queries, keys, and values from its current denoising state, while the video stream supplies visual keys and values. We concatenate the video and geometric keys and values along the token dimension, allowing each geometric query to attend jointly to scene features and video priors. The resulting attention output passes through the geometric stream’s output projection, residual connection, and feed-forward layers to update its tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 Fast-WAM（Yuan 等人，2026）的共享注意力设计，通过注意力机制将视频先验令牌与几何潜在令牌耦合，同时保留独立的处理流。 在每个耦合层中，模态特定的投影将两种表示映射到一个共同的注意力空间。 几何流从其当前的去噪状态生成查询、键和值，而视频流则提供视觉键和值。 我们将视频和几何的键与值沿令牌维度进行拼接，使每个几何查询能够同时关注场景特征和视频先验。 最终的注意力输出会经过几何流的输出投影、残差连接和前馈层，以更新其令牌。

sents.zh: 几何流从其当前的去噪状态生成查询、键和值，而视频流则提供视觉键和值。

sents.en: The resulting attention output passes through the geometric stream’s output projection, residual connection, and feed-forward layers to update its tokens.
sents.zh: 最终的注意力输出会经过几何流的输出投影、残差连接和前馈层，以更新其令牌。

paragraphs.en: The interaction is asymmetric: geometric tokens attend to the video stream, while video features remain independent of the evolving geometric state. We therefore compute and cache the video keys and values once, reusing them across denoising updates. Geometric queries, keys, and values are recomputed at each step. This variant introduces video information within the attention computation, whereas the ControlNet-style design injects it through an auxiliary residual branch.
paragraphs.zh: 这种交互是非对称的：几何标记会关注视频流，而视频特征则与不断变化的几何状态保持独立。 因此，我们只需计算并缓存一次视频键和值，然后在去噪更新过程中重复使用它们。 几何查询、键和值在每一步都会重新计算。 这种变体在注意力计算中引入了视频信息，而 ControlNet 风格的设计则是通过一个辅助残差分支来注入该信息。
